purpose: Offline feasibility only; no production source or behavior changed.

source.directTargetStrikePolicy: Direct strike events aimed at the reduced target plates are excluded; target receives only signed external Z/Sphere traces.

semantics.laplacian: L u at a masked node = -4u + sum of existing four-neighbor values; missing neighbors remain zero (Dirichlet boundary).
semantics.recurrence: next = 2u - previous - bending*L(Lu) + (tension/density)*Lu - effectiveDamping*(u-previous) + externalZ + externalSphere - linkDiagonal*u.
semantics.zInput: externalZ[i] = sum over adjacent-layer links coefficient*(otherCurrent)/density; linkDiagonal sums coefficient/density.
semantics.sphereInput: externalSphere[i] = sum weight*0.000025*modalContact/density; linkDiagonal includes sum weight*0.000025/density.
semantics.sleepQuietEnergy: next^2 + (next-current)^2 + bending*(L current)^2 >= 1e-10 blocks quiet sleep.
semantics.intraPlateWakeEnergy: next^2 + (next-current)^2 + (L(L current))^2*0.0001 > 1e-10 triggers production intra-Plate neighbor wake.
semantics.handoffTrigger: For this diagnostic only, reconstruct at the first sample where any target node crosses the exact production sleep quiet-energy threshold; this is not a proposed production wake policy.
semantics.feedbackLimit: Recorded inputs are open-loop. The full target replay matches the captured full solver at the same inputs, but ROM differences do not feed back into neighboring Plate or Sphere states.

basis.method: frozen-mask generalized modal projection; symmetric Plate stiffness includes exact masked L^2/L terms and frozen reciprocal-link diagonal stiffness; signed incoming Z/Sphere source terms are projected each step
basis.modalOrder: ascending eigenvalue of the positive restoring operator; no content-normalized or loudness-matched data

operationModel.fullPerStep: two masked stencils + about 9 recurrence operations per active node + the incoming Z/Sphere edge work
operationModel.reducedCorePerStep: the same incoming edge work + about 2 × meanInputNodes × r projection operations + 8r modal update/pickup operations
operationModel.exactWakeMonitoring: Exact local quiet-energy and intra-Plate wake checks reconstruct current and previous full fields (about 4Nr operations) and recalculate the two masked stencils; this cost is shown separately.
operationModel.breakEven: The reported approximate rank compares reduced projection/update work to the Plate stencils and local recurrence after common coupling edge work cancels. It is arithmetic only, not a wall-clock speedup.
operationModel.fixedComputeFloor: Sphere modes continue in the current worklet even when Plate nodes sleep; the observed 32-nodule topology has 384 modes.
operationModel.timingLimit: No wall-clock timing or Chrome AudioWorklet runtime test was used as evidence.

verdict: See measured rank, handoff, and cost metrics; no production candidate is implied.
